extracted.name: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
extracted.description: A whipped cream cheese and pineapple juice dressing make this Hawaiian salad pretty special. It complements the other ingredients of pineapple chunks, chicken, grapes, and almonds perfectly. Chilling brings out all the flavors.
ingredient_lines: 0.33333334326744 cup creamy salad dressing, e.g. Miracle Whip ™
1 (8 ounce) can pineapple tidbits, juice reserved
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese in a medium bowl until fluffy. Mix in salad dressing and 2 tablespoons reserved pineapple juice.
Stir in pineapple tidbits, chicken, almonds, and grapes until evenly coated. Chill in the refrigerator until serving.
